The '''Rythani Products Building''', also known as '''Rythani Labs''', was a building belonging to weapons manufacturer [[Rythani Products]] located in [[Rydonni Prime]]'s [[Capital/Legends|capital]] [[City/Legends|city]] [[Ryell]]. Rythani Products developed a [[Rythani Products prototype|prototype]] weapon here in [[Prototype Lab A|one]] of their [[Prototype Labs]]. The weapon was being manufactured for the [[Galactic Empire/Legends|Galactic Empire]] before it was stolen by professional [[Scoundrel/Legends|thief]] [[Sienn Sconn]].<ref name="Easy Credits" />
